name: Settings demo
description: The example of a mod with its own settings page inside the FloofyCrew App (Requirement 16.4): a text field and a toggle persisted through floofy.mod(id).config, and a button calling the mod's own backend route, which the python-hook part registers with ctx.routes and which echoes the stored config. Unofficial; the second first-party mod.

parts.title: Settings demo
parts.description: the settings page the App mounts under Mods: greeting + toggle persisted with floofy.mod(id).config, a button calling the mod's echo route
registers the echo route (GET/POST) with ctx.routes; answers with the stored config
